title: feat(pm): fleet-roster --health, l1-face --pr N and the same-day churn pointer replace three retyped seat readings
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuANuPSyQBj6gwMRXQAhogNB)_

Part of #35237
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:产品用户无感;车队席位从此一条命令读出每轮报告里的五项健康指标,另一条命令读出单个合并请求在一级审核清单里能机械判定的各项及其证据;派发时"当天合并"那一行也改由已有的命令读出。
- 为什么做:这是车队流程脚本化专题的第三、五、六片,替执行席和分诊席省掉每轮照着规则文字手工重做的读数,那样做容易漏读、读错。
- 出错会怎样:两个脚本只读不写,出错最多给席位一个错误读数;读不全时明说"不完整"并点名缺口,不给看似干净的结果;规则文字一改,脚本自检就报红;整单可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无,席位按审核记录落地。

## What changes

Slices 3, 5 and 6 of the card. Two readers and one pointer replace procedures the dispatch rules spell as prose and every seat retypes. Each prose line keeps its rule sentence and names the command as its reading.

- **`scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs --health` (slice 3).** Read-only; `--health --write` is a usage error. It prints the round report's five health indicators as `seat-lifecycle.md` defines them, one line each, under a header with the reading time and the repos read.
  - One walk per repo: the first-touch sweep's own walk (`first-touch-sweep.mjs` `sweep`, imported, never re-spelled), tapped through an injected reader. The bare-card count is disjunction ① off that walk, and the ungraded count is disjunction ④. The inventory, the decision cards, `finding` and `priority:p0` are counted off the same rows.
  - Every count is checked against its platform `total_count` (`perPage: 1` search, runbook 之三). The checks cover the four label counts, the open-issue total against the walk, and the awaiting-merge pulls listed against their total. A mismatch, an `incomplete_results`, an unreadable thread or an unreadable repo is a named gap, and the run reads INCOMPLETE.
  - 决策箱 prints `决策卡 N · 待您审合 PR M` apart and never summed, through `inboxTotals` (reused). The downstream reverse read uses `blockerTargetsFor` (reused) over every open card's body and every `pm:blocked` card's thread.
  - Measured readings for the open legs (A3, A4):
    - The trend has no durable earlier reading. The roster body carries the inbox line only, and the round report lives in chat.
    - 「三仓」 and 窗内 are not settled by the rule text, and its neighbour names two boards. The run sums the repos it read and says so.
    - All three are printed as unread legs on every run, never guessed.
  - Live search reads are spaced 2.5 s apart. A search refused for the secondary rate limit is waited 60 s and read once more. A count still refused stays a named gap.
  - Exits: 0 complete · 2 usage · 3 no repo answered, or the fixture has no health section · 4 INCOMPLETE. Exit 4 is shared with `EXIT_REFUSED`, which only `--write` answers; the header comment says so.
- **`dispatch-runbook.md` same-day churn line (slice 5).** The hand-typed `git log` is replaced by `check-prior-rulings.mjs --paths` ②, which already runs it and prints the line. The `该行原文:…` line (A5's pin) is unchanged. No other runbook passage retypes a slice 1 or slice 2 script. The first-touch sweep line (`list_issues` + `since`) is `first-touch-sweep.mjs`'s procedure, not a slice 1 or 2 script, so it is not taken here.
- **`scripts/pm/l1-face.mjs --pr N` (slice 6, new).** Read-only. It prints the MECHANICAL face of `l1-review-checklist.md` for one PR at its current head. Each of 13 items gets one line with its verdict (`ok` / `flag` / `not measured`) and the evidence:
  - PR shape;
  - the first line after the harness and seat attribution lines naming the card;
  - the card relation, which flags H7 and flags `Fixes` on a card still in the decision inbox;
  - a closing keyword bound to another OPEN card;
  - the release path;
  - a changeset entry per touched package whose `package.json` at the head is not `private: true`, or the `skip-changeset` label;
  - empty changesets;
  - the `Clause-②:` and `Metadata-protocol:` lines;
  - the `Skills-docs:` line when owed, which flags `follow-up owed`;
  - `Lint & Repo Gates` and `TypeScript Type Check` at the head;
  - every other check, via pr-state;
  - dogfood owed (flagged, not judged);
  - `+0/-0` files, decided by the blob's NUL count and line count.

  The owed sentence-by-sentence reads (changeset/CHANGELOG, `content/docs/**`, `apps/docs/**`) are listed. A footer names the 11 judgement items it does not read, so an absent face never reads as clean.
  - Reused, not re-spelled:
    - `readPrState` and `fixtureReaders` (pr-state). The PR row and the check-run rows are tapped off pr-state's own walk, so every item is judged at the head pr-state read.
    - `closingKeywordTargets`, `partOfDeclarationTargets`, `partOfTargets`, `refsTargets`, `h7PartOfWithClosingKeyword`, `SEAT_SIGNATURE_LINE` and `DECISION_INBOX_LABEL` (check-half-states, the registered shared parser; no fourth).
    - `readClause2Line` and `readMetadataProtocolLine` (clause2-line).
    - `entriesIn` (check-changeset-no-major; no fifth copy of the entry regex).
    - `landDogfoodMarkers` (label-write).
    - `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS`, which the self-test asserts carries both floor names.
  - Exits: 0 clean · 2 usage · 3 PR row unreadable · 4 INCOMPLETE (a not-measured item wins over a flag) · 5 FLAGGED. None is a merge condition; this is a reader, not a gate. Wired into `check:pm-expected-skips` beside the other PR readers.
- **Pointers.** All are at ≤ 120 B per line, and every touched skill file keeps its line count.
  - `seat-lifecycle.md`: the 76th line, 98 → 98.
  - `dispatch-runbook.md`: the 57th and 221st lines, 245 → 245.
  - `l1-review-checklist.md`: the three mechanical section headings and the `+0/-0` line, 80 → 80.

  No ceiling row moves, and no issue number appears in a skill line.

## Live run

Every run below was read against the live board.

<details><summary>fleet-roster --health --repos objectstack-ai/objectstack,objectstack-ai/hotcrm at 588e5aa0: COMPLETE, exit 0 (122 s)</summary>

```text
fleet-roster --health — read 2026-11-19T22:26:33Z · repos objectstack-ai/objectstack, objectstack-ai/hotcrm · read-only, nothing written
walk: objectstack-ai/objectstack 470 open issue(s) over 6 page(s) · the platform counts 470 · objectstack-ai/hotcrm 36 open issue(s) over 1 page(s) · the platform counts 36
1 可派发库存 — open pm:queue, no assignee: 266 (objectstack 262 · hotcrm 4) · trend unread (named below)
2 决策箱 — 决策卡 10 · 待您审合 PR 6 (two inboxes, never summed) · decision cards an open card names on a Blocked-by: line (reverse read, now): 0 of 10
3 finding — 75 open (the bare label is the ungraded count; a held card has changed label), median age 47h (objectstack 74 · hotcrm 1)
4 裸卡 — 3 bare (objectstack 2 · hotcrm 1; first-touch-sweep ①, off the sweep's own walk), median age under 1h (printed with a less-than sign) = first-touch debt · ungraded (④) 0
5 发版阻塞 — open priority:p0 issues summed over the repos read: 0 (objectstack 0 · hotcrm 0); zero means every board read is empty · the total open count is deliberately not an indicator
fleet-roster --health COMPLETE — five indicators, every count checked against the platform's.
```

The five unread legs print under every run, as the second block shows.

</details>

<details><summary>the same run twenty minutes earlier: INCOMPLETE, exit 4, because the board moved during the read</summary>

The two gaps were `the walk returned 471 open issue(s) and the platform counts 470` and `queue: the walk holds 270 and the platform counts 269`. A card moved between the walk and the count, and the run said so instead of printing either number as clean.

</details>

<details><summary>fleet-roster --health with the default repos at 9b6aa7bd: INCOMPLETE, exit 4 (before the secondary-limit wait)</summary>

The six gaps:
- `objectstack-ai/objectui` and `objectstack-ai/mobile` could not be read. This session's token has no access to them, which is expected from this project.
- Four hotcrm counts were refused for the search API's secondary rate limit. This run is why the one-wait re-read was added in 588e5aa0.

The five unread legs, as printed:

```text
  · the inventory's trend (可派发库存 …及趋势) — a trend needs an earlier reading of the same count and none is durable: the roster body carries the inbox line only and the round report lives in the chat channel; compare with the previous round's line by hand
  · 发版阻塞's 「三仓」 — the rule names no repos and its neighbour (`seat-post-protocol.md` 发版板运维) names two boards, the main repo and cloud; this run sums the repos it read (`--repos`; the default list holds no cloud board)
  · the release window (窗内) — the rule names no machine reading of it; every open p0 counts, main-red anchors included, as the maintainer's own query lists them
  · a `Blocked-by:` line in a comment of a card that is not `pm:blocked` — the body line is read on every open card, the thread only on `pm:blocked` cards
  · a downstream card in a repository outside `--repos` — the reverse read sees only the repos read
```

</details>

```text
Owed sentence-by-sentence reads (changeset/CHANGELOG, content/docs, apps/docs): none in the diff
Not read by this face — the reviewer's own judgement:

```

</details>

<details><summary>l1-face on two open PRs: 35591 CLEAN exit 0; 35641 CLEAN exit 0 after the seat-signature fix</summary>

- 35591, a draft whose first line binds its own card with a closing keyword: all 13 items `ok`, `l1-face CLEAN — 13 item(s) read, none flagged; the items above the footer are still the reviewer's.`
- 35641, which touches three published packages, carries one changeset and edits three `content/docs` pages. The first run flagged `first-line`: that body opens with the seat signature line `repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · SESSION`, not a harness comment. The signature is now an attribution line too, through `SEAT_SIGNATURE_LINE`, and a case pins it. The re-run reads `changeset ok — every published package touched has a changeset entry: @objectstack/core (packages/core, 1 file(s)), @objectstack/objectql (packages/objectql, 4 file(s)), @objectstack/spec (packages/spec, 7 file(s))`. It lists the four owed sentence-by-sentence reads (the changeset and the three `.mdx` pages) and exits 0.

The footer printed under every run:

```text
Not read by this face — the reviewer's own judgement:
  · whether `Fixes` is right — does merging deliver the whole card, or only the implementable half (then `Part of`)
  · the body read by eye past the parser: negations, bookkeeping sentences and quotes re-arm a close; a qualified OWNER/NAME#N is not read here
  · a `Part of` card keeps `pm:dispatched` until removed by hand (landing rule B), recorded at ACCEPT
  · files outside the card or past its `Scope-review:` line
  · whether the `Skills-docs:` value is true
  · whether a published package's touched files ship (`files[]`), and published defects this round made false or touched
  · adjacent in-place fixes (the four conditions), one-shot codegen in the diff, move/split growth past a pure move
  · test evidence: real commands and output, positive controls, `.d.ts` byte-identity readings, git-answerable API reads
  · gate readings in the report pinned to this head, and the report's `dogfood_battery` against it
  · assertions and benefit (the envelope `code`/`status`, sweep direction and build order), premise, stop conditions and deletions
  · `mergeable_state`, the queue and reviews — read with `pr-state.mjs` (its line is printed above)
```

</details>

## Tests

At head 588e5aa0:

- `node scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, `✓ fleet-roster self-test: 145 cases in 12 batteries pass.`
  - It has two new batteries. The first pins the rule text: every phrase `--health` is built from, in `seat-lifecycle.md`, `dispatch-runbook.md` and `seat-post-protocol.md`, the pointers included (floor 4).
  - The second covers `--health` itself (floor 23): the five indicators off one fixture walk, each count gap, the blind-sweep gap, the unreadable thread, the CAN'T READ repo, the unread legs, pacing, and the one-wait re-read. It also runs the CLI offline with `PATH=/nonexistent` (exits 4, 0, 3 and 2).
  - The battery floor rises from 10 to 12.
- `node scripts/pm/l1-face.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, `✓ l1-face self-test: 46 cases pass across 7 batteries — offline, no network.`
  - It pins 14 checklist phrases and 2 `os-dev.md` phrases, the pointer included.
  - It drives every item ok, flag and not-measured from offline fixtures, and runs the CLI from a temp fixture with no `gh` on PATH.
- Both run in their chains: `pnpm check:pm-record-recognisers` exits 0 and `pnpm check:pm-expected-skips` exits 0, with each success line in its log.

## Acceptance notes

- `Part of`: this PR lands slices 3, 5 and 6. Slice 4 (the in-flight overlap interception lines of the runbook) is not here, so the card stays open for it.
- The review reports' section 4 is not readable from this project. Each slice was read from its name in the dispatch order and from the rule lines it replaces.
- The `Blocked-by:` reverse read counts a decision card as having an open downstream card when an OPEN card in the repos read names it. Today that is 0 of 10 on the two readable boards; the fixture pins the nonzero shape across repos.
- No new CI job, and no exit code becomes a merge condition. Both scripts are readers.
- The worktree is kept after the PR opens, as the dispatch order asks.
- This PR moves `.claude/**` rule text, so a contract-tier L2 review is owed. The seat routes it.

## Verification

**Read first, by risk:**
1. `scripts/pm/l1-face.mjs`, `readFace`: the tap on pr-state's get, which is the only place the PR row and the check-run rows come from.
2. `scripts/pm/l1-face.mjs`, `changesetItems`: the package walk, where a 404 means no manifest at that directory and any other error means not measured.
3. `scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs`, `readHealthRepo`: the sweep tap and the count checks.

**Two-minute check:** `node scripts/pm/l1-face.mjs --self-test && node scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs --self-test` prints `✓ l1-face self-test: 51 cases pass across 7 batteries` and then `✓ fleet-roster self-test: 147 cases in 12 batteries pass.` (head 97682af4)

## Fix round 1 (head 97682af4)

Reviews on 588e5aa0 were L1-a ACCEPT and L2 PASS with one should-fix. This round takes S1, N1 to N7 and the L1 wording nit. N8 is accepted as it stands. The round adds +59/−30 over 3 files in three commits, and the whole PR is now 1281 changed lines (+1268/−13).

- **S1: a published package is no longer hidden behind a nested private manifest.** `changesetItems` now reads every manifest between a path and the root. The nearest manifest that is not `private: true` owns the path, and the nested private one is named on the line (`through private …`).
  - Measured over this tree's 26,269 tracked files and 134 manifests, this rule and workspace membership pick the same owner for every file. The nearest-manifest rule hid 27 files, all under the blank scaffold.
  - Workspace membership would need `pnpm-workspace.yaml` read at the head plus a glob matcher over remote paths. `expandWorkspaceGlob` reads the local filesystem, not the head. The chosen rule reads only manifests the walk already reads, and a nested private manifest fails loud.
  - Pinned by two cases: a nested private manifest inside a published one, and a changeset entry that names only the private one.
  - Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, owner = the nearest manifest): anchor 1 → 0, blob 45bea9f4ae50 → 5c988481bc60, 2 of 51 red. The red line is the reviewer's text, `no published package touched (unpublished: objectstack-blank)`. Restored: blob == HEAD 45bea9f4ae50, `git diff HEAD` empty.
  - Live: `l1-face --pr 32317` reads `create-objectstack (packages/create-objectstack, 3 file(s), through private objectstack-blank)`.
- **N1:** under `skip-changeset`, a published package with no entry now reads `flag` (flagged, not judged). The case that pinned `ok` now pins `flag`.
- **N2:** the unread footer gains the two items for who hangs `skip-changeset` and the dogfood-test grep for a send or write moved after the response. The self-test pins a phrase of each from the checklist.
- **N3:** a `+0/-0` rename is read by its blob like any other suspect. One case pins a rename whose blob holds NUL as `flag`.
- **N4:** a `_Requested by …_` line without the project-thread link is an attribution line.
- **N5:** an empty `Skills-docs:` value reads as no line, so owed and absent flags. The fence rule is now the shared `stripMarkdownCode(body, { inline: false })`.
- **N6:** `incomplete_results` on the awaiting-merge listing is a named gap, as it is for the four label counts.
- **N7:** each of the five indicator lines carries `⛔ INCOMPLETE run — not a clean reading (gaps below)` on an INCOMPLETE run. A run no repository answered prints no indicator line. Both are pinned.
- **L1 nit:** the `seat-lifecycle.md` pointer reads 「五项现读」. It stays on the finding line, because on the 「健康指标五个」 line it would be 157 B. On the finding line with its closing 「。」 it would be 123 B, so that one 「。」 is dropped to keep the line at 120 B. The file stays at 98 lines and the rule sentence is unchanged.
- **N8, accepted:** a bare `--health` reads INCOMPLETE from a project that cannot see every default repo. The rule lines and the default repo list stay as they are, and the unreadable repos are named as gaps on every run.
